jobs.title: Account Executive – European Government (Based in Netherlands / Belgium) Sales | Netherlands, NL
jobs.description: Toka ALL JOBS Account Executive – European Government (Based in Netherlands / Belgium) Sales Netherlands Full-time Description Toka provides advanced cyber and intelligence solutions to government, law enforcement, and national security agencies worldwide. Our mission is to empower those who protect their nations with the tools to combat evolving digital threats and safeguard critical infrastructure. We are looking for a high-impact Account Executive based in the Netherlands, Belgium, or Spain to drive Toka's expansion across European government, intelligence, and law enforcement markets. This is a complex, multi-country role requiring someone who can operate across cultures, navigate diverse regulatory environments, and build trust in highly sensitive government ecosystems. More than a strong salesperson, we are looking for a credible operator — someone who understands how European government systems work from the inside, and knows how to turn access into meaningful business. You are not new to this world — you've worked in it, around it, or closely alongside it. You understand the complexity of European government environments — the different stakeholders, the pace, the sensitivities, and the importance of trust. You know how to operate across borders, adapt your approach, and still drive deals forward. What You'll Do Drive Toka's expansion across multiple European markets and build a regional go-to-market strategy Build trusted relationships with government and intelligence stakeholders across Europe Identify, shape, and close new opportunities across multiple territories — owning the full sales cycle from opportunity creation to contract closure Navigate complex procurement processes across different European frameworks Position Toka's solutions in mission-critical use cases Requirements Based in the Netherlands, or Belgium Native French or Spanish speaker + fluent English Experience working in or with government, intelligence, or national security organizations in Europe Strong network within relevant agencies or ecosystems Proven success in B2G / government sales and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals Ability to obtain and maintain relevant European security clearances (as required) Background combining operational + commercial experience Willingness to travel extensively across Europe Advantages Additional European languages Experience in cybersecurity or intelligence technologies Experience working with European frameworks, partners, or integrators ALL JOBS

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer R&D | Tel Aviv, IL
jobs.description: Toka ALL JOBS Senior Backend Engineer R&D Tel Aviv Senior Full-time Description Role Description We are developing products and intelligence solutions in the Cyber and IoT domains. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will design and implement backend services, lead architectural decisions, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and mentor junior developers. You will take ownership of complex tasks, manage project flows within your squad, and bring strong technical opinions and architectural insights. The role requires excellent multitasking skills, strong context-switching ability, and a proactive, mission-driven mindset. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and microservices. Lead and participate in architectural planning, proposing high-quality solutions and improvements. Work closely with product, frontend, DevOps, and data teams to deliver end-to-end features. Break down complex tasks, manage project execution within the team, and ensure on-time delivery. Mentor junior engineers and support onboarding of new team members. Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code following industry best practices. Develop integrations with various internal and external systems using diverse interface protocols. Maintain ownership of features from design through deployment and ongoing operation. Requirements 5+ years of backend development experience Strong proficiency in High-Level language Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (K8s) Experience with databases (SQL or NoSQL) Experience with queue brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, etc.) Experience working with distributed systems or microservices architectures ﻿Solid understanding of REST API design principles Highly versatile and adaptive engineer (“ninja” mindset) able to multitask, switch context smoothly, and quickly master new technologies. Proactive and goal-driven, who takes ownership, drives initiatives, and ensures project completion. Strong coordination abilities, capable of distributing tasks within a team and guiding execution. Effective mentor, supporting growth and onboarding of junior engineers. Independent and self-sufficient, while also an excellent team collaborator. Experienced with multiple architectures, capable of evaluating system design choices and forming informed technical opinions. Confident communicator, able to influence direction and express technical viewpoints while also knowing when compromise is appropriate. Advantages Familiarity with asyncio Understanding of networking concepts and network protocols Experience with JavaScript Experience with FFmpeg Experience with CI/CD processes Familiarity with the cyber world Experience with MongoDB ALL JOBS

In this role, you will research proprietary technologies and analyze complex IoT and embedded devices. You will be responsible for taking your research from initial discovery to a full end-to-end solution in production. Requirements 8+ years of relevant industry experience as a low-level vulnerability researcher. Proven track record of finding memory corruption vulnerabilities (stack/heap overflows, UAF, TOCTOU, etc.). Proven track record of developing complex exploits. Excellent understanding of common security mitigations such as ASLR, DEP, and CFI. Excellent understanding OS internals, network protocols and cryptography concepts. Proficient in Assembly, C, and Python. Expert with IDA Pro / Ghidra, and GDB. Advantages B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Mathematics, or Engineering. Published research (CVEs, blog posts, or talks). Experience with RF communication schemes such as WiFi, Bluetooth, GPS… Experience with developing / researching in Android / iOS environments. ALL JOBS
